import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.8,
})

k_values = [0, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256]
llama_ppl = [8.0922, 8.1243, 8.1803, 8.2259, 8.4378, 9.0506, 11.991, 40.2067, 1519.19]
mistral_ppl = [7.1308, 7.1471, 7.164, 7.2001, 7.31, 7.4877, 7.5932, 7.5932, 7.5932]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 3.5))

ax.plot(range(len(k_values)), llama_ppl, color='#0072B2', marker='o', markersize=5,
        label='Llama-3.1-8B (spike)', zorder=3)
ax.plot(range(len(k_values)), mistral_ppl, color='#CC79A7', marker='s', markersize=5,
        label='Mistral-7B-v0.3 (flat)', zorder=3)

ax.set_yscale('log')
ax.set_xticks(range(len(k_values)))
ax.set_xticklabels([str(k) for k in k_values])
ax.set_xlabel('Cardinality constraint $k$')
ax.set_ylabel('Perplexity (WikiText-2)')

ax.annotate(f'{llama_ppl[-1]/llama_ppl[0]:.0f}× baseline',
            xy=(len(k_values)-1, llama_ppl[-1]),
            xytext=(-60, -18), textcoords='offset points',
            fontsize=9, color='#0072B2',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#0072B2', lw=1.0))

ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(matplotlib.ticker.ScalarFormatter())
ax.yaxis.set_minor_formatter(matplotlib.ticker.NullFormatter())
ax.set_yticks([7, 8, 10, 15, 30, 100, 500, 1500])
ax.get_yaxis().set_major_formatter(matplotlib.ticker.FuncFormatter(lambda x, _: f'{x:g}'))

ax.grid(True, which='major', alpha=0.25, linewidth=0.6)
ax.grid(True, which='minor', alpha=0.15, linewidth=0.4)

ax.legend(frameon=True, fancybox=False, edgecolor='#cccccc', framealpha=0.9)

plt.tight_layout()
fig.savefig('/root/ratekv/artifacts/fig_compounding_curves.pdf')
fig.savefig('/root/ratekv/artifacts/fig_compounding_curves.png')
print('Saved PDF and PNG.')
PYEOF
